nodes.speaker: Bartender
nodes.text: Welcome to the Tavern! Pull up a seat. We serve ideas here, not drinks.

nodes.speaker: Bartender
text: Brain Dump is an AI-powered note-taking app. You throw in raw thoughts and it helps organize them.
Think of it like a conversation with your own brain. You talk, it listens, and together you make sense of the mess.

nodes.speaker: Bartender
nodes.text: See that glowing doorway on the right? Step through it to launch Brain Dump. Fair warning — the owner needs to be logged in for this one.

nodes.speaker: Bartender
nodes.text: Take your time. Check out the barrels, the tables... it's cozy in here. The portal is on the right whenever you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Bartender
nodes.text: Press ESC anytime to head back outside. See you around!
